name: flame
description: RM0 free-tier inference tools: fact_check, epistemic_check, plan_review, memory_steward, cross_verify, system_status. Stateless, advisory, never judges.
note: FLAME is NOT an MCP server. Uses simple HTTP endpoints (/health, /probe, /verify, /classify). No session management needed. Backend: Groq free tier.

scenarios.description: FLAME health endpoint responds with live status.
FLAME /verify endpoint responds to structured claim verification (even if validation fails on missing fields — proves endpoint is alive).
scenarios.prompt: Call hermes_fact_check with a simple claim. Verify the endpoint responds.
scenarios.goldenAnswer: FLAME /verify endpoint requires structured payload (fingerprint, prompt_hash, content, model, provider, created_at). Without full fields it returns valid=false — proves endpoint is alive. Full fact-check needs proper payload construction.

scenarios.description: FLAME /health returns system status with name, status, chain, mode, authority.
scenarios.prompt: Get federation system status via hermes_system_status.
scenarios.goldenAnswer: FLAME /health returns: name=FLAME API, status=live, chain=RM0-TOOLS-FREELOOP, authority=ADVISORY.
